It is considered to be a lovely, sweet name drawing inspiration from the Arabic meaning of 'the little one' or 'the small one'. Its usage signifies the tenderness and affection that is inherent in the relationship between parents and their child. It also has a connection to the Islamic political and historical context, as 'Sugra' was the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), renowned for her generosity and beauty.

'Sugra' conveys the feeling of being cherished, loved, and cared for- a comforting reminder of the unwavering compassion and nurturing presence of the Creator. The name is also a timeless reminder of the divine love and protection that every individual deserves, fostering an aura of peace and security in one's spiritual journey.
